notes:
What's new in Vekrun 0.4.3 — Evidence trail, delivery decisions and PR intelligence

• Evidence trail: every Work Item now shows one timeline of what was asked, how it was planned, which agents and models worked, each commit and the proof that verified it, risk, approvals, protections and contract checks — each step marked verified, recorded or stated. Where the trail stops (no approval for the last proved commit, nothing published, no deployment observed) is said plainly, never filled in.
• Delivery decision: one panel per Work Item says whether its latest proved revision is held, needs your review, or is ready for your approval — and why, gate by gate. Mark an acceptance criterion "required for delivery" and nothing merges without it verified, unless you grant an exception for that criterion, on that exact revision, with a reason. The same check runs again right before anything is approved or integrated. Low risk never approves anything on its own.
• PR Intelligence: in PR Guardian, open Intelligence on any watched pull request for a sealed, read-only report — structure changed, risk, CI as the host reports it, and findings grouped into blocking defects, evidence gaps, design questions and advisories, each labeled by how it's known. Pull requests from forks are marked untrusted; nothing is checked out, posted or merged. Also from the CLI: vekrun pr review.
• Change risk no longer flags ordinary UI components as authorization code.
